admissible_implementation.credit: Source conditional prefix/capability preparation only; zero physical-mesh, complete native-cut, whole-loop or conservation/biological credit.
admissible_implementation.explicit_owner_sidecar: Reuse existing stable CutPlan/OwnedField removal ledgers separately from native arrays, recording disagreement instead of repairing source.
admissible_implementation.lifecycle: Ordered capability and epoch/invalidation gate for source continuation; require explicit changing geometry, operators, diffusion, profile/callback/RNG, GRN/channel and typed checkpoint owners.
admissible_implementation.prefix: Literal native deletion/hurt/ECM-target/vertex prefix up to the first mesh call, preserving all actual arrays/alias mutations and failure partials. No mesh or source numerical evaluation during preparation.
admissible_implementation.refusal: Current frozen ordinary event state cannot be resumed after cut. Missing/unqualified geometry or owner/rebind evidence is a deliberate prerequisite refusal, retaining prefix return and source failure evidence.

cache_semantics.channels: Actual init_channel is called again after molecules/transporters, resetting gate/route/core state; no hot gate remap or constructor skipping.
cache_semantics.diffusion: initDenv resets D_env,D_env_weight,D_env_weight_base,TJ_modulator,TJ_targets,Chi; no reinitialization of D_env_base shown in _cut_cells.
cache_semantics.fields: Geometry/graph operators rebuilt; sigma_env/ko_env and other initializer caches are not explicitly refreshed here; shape coincidences cannot authorize cache reuse.
cache_semantics.molecules: remove_cells deletes cell/membrane concentrations, refreshes profiles/growth, preserves ECM arrays; flux_intra deletion is assigned to cc_grad_x while old flux_intra persists.
cache_semantics.profiles: init_profiles writes current Dm_cells; outer makeAllChanges later overwrites it from retained/deleted Dm_base+Dm_scheduled, not newly fabricated bases.
cache_semantics.rate_RNG: Source dynamic/cache clocks and complete local RNG/repeated picker/finalizer epochs need explicit records. Source cut does not supply a sealed full ordinary checkpoint.

findings: ECM cc_env is excluded from special nesting but still enters generic length classification; species count equal cell/membrane count can corrupt a global grid array.
Scalar NumPy arrays can fail len; nested unknown lengths can reuse stale data2 or raise; list deletion can fail after partial mutation.
DEC cut_mesh documentation promises restructure edge indices but returns removed edges; dangling geometry/operator limitations remain unqualified.
ATP/cell-content release and sigma recomputation are commented out, not native material/energy mechanisms.
Native source repeats profile mapping and callback/finalizer construction; RNG consumption cannot be replaced by one old owner map or one seed.

owner_semantics.Cells: Existing betse_tissue_cut explicit owner-domain/axis/stable-ID maps are a separate conservative policy, not native deletion equivalence.
owner_semantics.aliases: Lists mutate in place and then retain only data[index]; data2 may be stale/unbound for unmatched nested rows. Capture full available parent/partial and original exception.
owner_semantics.empty: Original call still rebuilds mesh/profiles/diffusion for an empty typed selection; cannot treat native no-op as stable CutPlan.changed False.
owner_semantics.native: Hardcoded nested-name set and cell-first length heuristics; np.delete defaults to flattening without axis; arbitrary simulator attributes and histories are scanned.
owner_semantics.sequential: Multiple cut profiles select against each newly changed world; no pre-union of initial indices.

profile_reinitialization: Each molecule.remove_cells invokes init_profiles before its own init_growth; inner _cut_cells invokes it again; outer cut dispatch invokes it again after all cuts. Repeated pickers and RNG sites remain separate actual calls.
